title: teucrium collincola
intro: Teucrium collincola, commonly known as alpine germander, is a plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This perennial herb is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Teucrium collincola include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, diterpenes, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective effects.
